propositions: After a successful new-writer save, the last_get_pass inline field must be absent from every entry in bindings.json
The save path must persist rotation state to get_rotation.json before removing inline last_get_pass and writing bindings.json atomically
When sidecar persistence fails, the primary binding save must succeed with the latest inline value retained as a failure floor
A crash after sidecar persistence but before bindings replacement must not lose the maximum rotation timestamp already durable in the sidecar
An old-writer followed by new-writer sequence must migrate any later inline timestamp into get_rotation.json and converge to sidecar-only state
